description: This file defines a class `_PROXY_LiteLLMManagedFiles` which manages LiteLLM-managed files in a FastAPI-based proxy environment. It provides methods for storing, retrieving, deleting, and manipulating file objects and their IDs, including handling of base64 conversions of stored files, access controls, and hooks for pre- and post-call processing in a proxy. The class interacts with caching systems, databases via Prisma, and external storage backends. It is integral to managing model-specific file IDs, unified IDs, and ensuring secure access within a larger machine learning proxy framework.

classes.name: _PROXY_LiteLLMManagedFiles
classes.description: A class for managing LiteLLM files in a proxy setting. It handles storing, retrieving, deleting files, generating unified IDs, converting stored files to base64 for compatibility with specific providers, and various hooks to integrate with a larger ML proxy system.
